project_context.name: Metroconet
project_context.description: High-converting authorized retailer for Metronet fiber internet. Dark theme, aggressive conversion funnel, premium tech/Awwwards-level design.
project_context.primary_goal: Drive users to 'Order Now' and the pricing/plan selection funnel.
project_context.vibe: Modern, fast, premium, technological, energetic, credible.

black.usage: Primary canvas, global background. Never use gradients for the main background. Use for extreme contrast text on Yellow/Green badges.

purple.usage: Dominant branded interactive accent. Use for focus rings, outline CTA borders, interactive links, 'neon' glowing tracing lines around spotlight pricing cards.

green.usage: Primary conversion color. Use for 'Order Now' buttons (with black text), pricing numbers, checkmarks, success states, and savings callouts.

white.usage: Major text contrast. Primary headings, main body copy. Icons on dark backgrounds.

gray.usage: Secondary copy, muted meta-text, subtle 1px structural borders on cards.

navy.usage: Layered dark section backgrounds. Use for pricing card bases, input field backgrounds, and alternate section backgrounds on top of the black canvas.

teal.usage: Selective secondary accent for secondary icons or subtle data visualizations.

yellow.usage: Promotional flags and limited-attention markers. Use sparingly for 'First Month Free' or 'Limited Time' badges (must use black text for contrast).

color_rules.background_hierarchy: Root bg is #000000. Elevated surfaces (cards, modals) are #212145 (Navy).
color_rules.text_contrast: Body text must be #FFFFFF. Muted text is #6E6E70. Any text on #00C800 (Green) or #FFFF00 (Yellow) must be #000000.
color_rules.forbidden: No transparent backgrounds for headers/dropdowns. No generic gray gradients.

display.usage: All Headings (H1-H6), pricing numbers, and large display numbers for chapters.

body.usage: Paragraphs, tooltips, buttons, form inputs, secondary UI elements.

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl font-extrabold tracking-tighter leading-none text-[#FFFFFF]

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento-style layout for feature sections. 12-column grid for standard wrappers.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl (16px) for cards, rounded-full for buttons and badges.

lenis.config: { duration: 1.2, easing: (t) => Math.min(1, 1.001 - Math.pow(2, -10 * t)), direction: 'vertical', gestureDirection: 'vertical', smooth: true, mouseMultiplier: 1, smoothTouch: false, touchMultiplier: 2, infinite: false }

hero_kinetic_reveal.description: Masked line-by-line text reveal on H1.

scroll_reveal.description: Framer motion whileInView fade-up for cards and chapters.

imagery.direction: Real product/photography imagery treated deliberately. Spotlight lighting, clipped/angled frames, dark-canvas compositing. Never use raw rectangles. Use CSS masks or angled border-radius (e.g., rounded-tl-[100px] rounded-br-[100px]) for imagery blocks.

accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute using kebab-case, role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='order-now-button', data-testid='pricing-card-1gig').
accessibility.focus: All focusable elements must have visible focus rings: focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-[#964DFF] focus:ring-offset-2 focus:ring-offset-[#000000].

instructions_to_main_agent.1: Use ONLY valid JSON. Use standard HTML/React/Tailwind semantics when generating the actual files.
instructions_to_main_agent.2: Avoid Shadcn's basic Card components for the hero and core marketing sections to retain absolute structural freedom; use primitive divs with Tailwind. Use Shadcn strictly for Forms, Dialogs, Selects.
instructions_to_main_agent.3: Always include `framer-motion` for page load and scroll animations. Build a kinetic H1 component in the hero.
instructions_to_main_agent.4: The Zip Code Availability checker must be secondary in the hero layout. Do not let it overshadow the primary 'View Plans' or 'Order Now' messaging.
instructions_to_main_agent.5: Do NOT use transparent navigation backgrounds when content scrolls beneath. The header must have `bg-[#212145]/90 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-[#6E6E70]`.
instructions_to_main_agent.6: Add `react-fast-marquee` to the dependencies to build the Editorial Marquee section.
instructions_to_main_agent.7: Do not skip creating the Sticky Mobile CTA for small viewports. It is mandatory for conversion.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do NOT use dark colors as gradients. Stick to solid #000000 and #212145.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. No .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped) with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, custom cursors, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
Use provided Image URLs. Missing categories = agent uses placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN.
